caption: The drawing shows two wooden objects placed against a plain, light beige background. On the left is a round, shallow disk with a carved design featuring a central sheaf of wheat surrounded by a pattern of dots and a circular border. The object is rendered in shades of tan and brown, with darker shadowing on the left side indicating light from the right. On the right is a square, shallow block with slightly beveled edges and a raised border. The inner part of the square displays a carved sheaf of wheat with stylized stems and grain, surrounded by a line pattern that follows the shape of the border. This square object is colored in similar tan and brown hues, and the right side is shaded more heavily to suggest depth and shadow, matching the overall light direction in the composition. Both objects are spaced apart, centered horizontally in the drawing with ample empty space around them.
title: Butter Molds
